**Question.** After the OS-side campaign, what remains, and who can return it?

| reclaimed per node so far | |
| --- | --- |
| 64K pages (memmap) | 2.10 GiB |
| kernel rebuild, no random kmalloc caches | 0.74 GiB |
| idle NIC PF unbind | 0.42 GiB |
| OS strip | 0.2 GiB |

| remains, firmware-owned | |
| --- | --- |
| display/GSP carveout at `0x280000000` | 2,616 MiB |
| 15 smaller nomap regions | 1,018 MiB |
| GSP boot heap (largest single nvidia stack in page_owner) | 512 MiB |

The [DGX Spark release notes](https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgx-spark/release-notes.html)
list Display Reserved Memory as BIOS-adjustable between 2 GB and 4 GB. The
control exists; only a larger option shipped. A headless cluster node uses
neither.

The ask, going to the DGX Spark / GB10 developer forum: a 0 GB or minimal
display carveout setting for headless and appliance use. Per node that is up
to 2.55 GiB; across this pair, 5.1 GiB. Firmware here is
GX10DGX.0105.2026.0505.1153.

**Verdict.** Open. Waiting on NVIDIA.

**Reopen if.**

- a firmware release changes any carveout size, or the forum thread answers
  what the smaller regions hold
